title: Monty Python’s Spamalot
venue: The Muse Theatre, Lipson Co-operative Academy, Bernice Terrace, Plymouth, PL4 7PG
description: Join King Arthur and his wonderfully unlikely Knights of the Round Table on a chaotic quest for the Holy Grail. Inspired by Monty Python and the Holy Grail, Spamalot combines outrageous comedy, musical spectacle and gloriously daft encounters, from taunting French soldiers to the Knights Who Say ‘Ni!’.
credits:
Director & choreographer: Heather Jenkin
Assistant choreographer: Beth Emmet
Producer: Adele Tremeer
Musical director: Joshua Clarke

Book and lyrics by Eric Idle
Music by John Du Prez and Eric Idle
